name: Aplos
shortDescription: Nonprofit and church accounting software with fund accounting, financial reporting, donations and operational management tools.
suitableContexts: Treasurers needing financial reports by fund

pricing.summary: Aplos publishes US-dollar Lite, Core, Advanced and custom plans, plus a 15-day free trial.

startingPrice.qualifier: Lite list price; promotional prices may vary

tiers.label: Lite
tiers.detail: Two users and core fund-accounting reports

tiers.label: Core
tiers.detail: Adds budgeting, payables, receivables and integrations

tiers.label: Advanced
tiers.detail: For larger organisations; supplier says customised solutions begin here

editorial.assessment: Aplos is primarily a fund-accounting decision. Its US-dollar pricing and US nonprofit features mean a UK church should validate VAT, Gift Aid, statutory reporting, bank connections and accountant workflow before using it as its ledger.
bestFor: Treasurers needing fund accounting and board reporting
strengths: Fund-accounting reporting is central to the product
limitations: UK charity, VAT and Gift Aid fit is not confirmed

procurementVerdict.problem: Treasurers needing fund accounting and board reporting

longForm.verdict: Aplos can be a useful accounting shortlist option when fund reporting is the primary need, but it should be assessed by the treasurer and accountant against UK requirements before any migration.

decisionLens.heading: Fund accounting is not the same as UK charity accounting fit.
decisionLens.text: A product may track designated funds well while still not match UK VAT, Gift Aid, reporting and banking needs. The decision should be led by the people accountable for the books.

sections.heading: A finance-led trial
sections.question: Can the church recreate its actual financial controls?
paragraphs: Aplos publishes fund accounting, bank reconciliation, reporting and paid tiers that add budgeting, payables and receivables.
Use the trial with a copy of a recent month: funds, bank reconciliation, reports and exports. Do not use a trial to infer UK tax or Gift Aid treatment without direct confirmation.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score; it is based on Aplos’s pricing and product information.
themes: Fund reporting is the key product proposition.
A treasurer-led test is more useful than generic feature comparison.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier descriptions do not establish UK accounting or regulatory suitability.

faq.question: Does Aplos have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Aplos advertises a 15-day trial without a credit card.

faq.question: How much does Aplos cost?
faq.answer: The supplier publishes Lite at $79/month, Core at $129/month and Advanced from $229/month, with custom pricing for larger organisations.

faq.question: Is Aplos suitable for UK church accounting?
faq.answer: Not confirmed. Verify VAT, Gift Aid, UK reporting, banking and accountant requirements before adoption.

seo.title: Aplos review for UK churches
seo.description: Independent Aplos profile for UK churches: fund accounting, pricing, trial, UK finance checks and FAQs.
